capabilities: Sync vault files two ways through S3-compatible storage
Propagate uploads, downloads, and deletes across devices
Create conflict copies when both sides edited a file
Encrypt a protected folder with AES-256-GCM before upload
Ignore configured globs and always skip config and trash folders
extras: Not yet in Community plugins at the time of writing (install listed as 'after approval'); manual install and BRAT are documented. By default files are stored unencrypted in the bucket; only the optional protected folder is encrypted. Credentials are stored in plaintext in the vault's plugin data (data.json) on each device. On desktop, Node fs is used to write already-encrypted note contents when Obsidian quits or hides with a protected folder unlocked.
problem: Obsidian's built-in sync is a paid service, and users who already have S3-compatible storage have no first-party way to keep multiple devices' vaults in sync through it.

requires.name: S3-compatible storage bucket (Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Backblaze B2, MinIO, or other SigV4 S3 API)
S3 access key and secret with list/get/put/delete permissions

summary: Two-way vault sync plugin that replicates notes across devices through S3-compatible object storage such as Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, Backblaze B2, and MinIO.
